claims.claim_text: Arrival has a purchase order from UPS for 10,000 vans at a total aggregate price of $1.2 billion, with an option for an additional 10,000 vans.
claims.subject: Arrival
claims.source_quote: Arrival is party to an agreement with UPS whereby UPS has agreed to purchase 10,000 vans from Arrival for a total aggregate purchase price of $1.2 billion. This agreement also provides UPS with an option to purchase an additional 10,000 vans from Arrival.

claims.claim_text: Arrival has filed approximately 203 patent innovations in the United States, United Kingdom, and European patent offices.

claims.object_value: 203 filed patent innovations across USPTO, UKIPO, and EPO
claims.source_quote: As of November 30, 2020, Arrival has approximately 203 innovations that have been filed in various jurisdictions including the United States Patent and Trademark Office ( USPTO ), United Kingdom Intellectual Property Office ( UKIPO ) and the European Patent Office ( EPO ).

claims.claim_text: Arrival has a business collaboration agreement with HKMC to jointly develop vehicles using Arrival's skateboard platform, microfactories, and software.
claims.subject: Arrival
claims.source_quote: CIIG s board of directors considered Arrival s business collaboration agreement with HKMC, which contemplates that Arrival and HKMC will jointly develop vehicles using Arrival s skateboard platform, microfactories and software.

claims.claim_text: Arrival has a research and development team consisting of over 1,100 people.
claims.subject: Arrival
claims.source_quote: Arrival s research and development team consist of over 1,100 people with many from multidisciplinary backgrounds and education.

claims.claim_text: Arrival owns or controls approximately 70% of the Arrival Van and approximately 40% of the materials used to produce the Arrival Bus.
claims.subject: Arrival
claims.object_value: 70% of Van components / 40% of Bus materials
claims.source_quote: As a result of Arrival s vertically integrated approach and strong IP portfolios, up to approximately 70% of the Arrival Van and approximately 40% of the materials used to produce the Arrival Bus is either owned or controlled by Arrival.

claims.claim_text: Arrival has a software engineering team consisting of more than 500 software engineers with a software engineer to mechanical engineer ratio of approximately 1:1.
claims.subject: Arrival
claims.source_quote: Arrival s software team consists of more than 500 software engineers. Its software engineer to mechanical engineer ratio is 1:1, which it believes compares favorably to an estimated traditional OEM ratio of approximately 1:100.

claims.claim_text: Arrival has a total staff of over 1,400 employees, with over 85% being engineers including software engineers.
claims.subject: Arrival
claims.source_quote: Arrival sets itself apart from its industry peers by its sizable staff of over 1,400 employees, over 85% of whom are engineers (including software engineers).

claims.claim_text: UPS invested EUR 10,000,000 for 2,933,334 Preferred A Shares in Arrival, with potential conversion rights up to 3% of order value if a binding agreement is entered for an additional 10,000+ vehicles.
claims.subject: Arrival
claims.object_value: UPS / EUR 10,000,000 / equity and conversion rights
claims.source_quote: On January 29, 2020, these shares were subscribed by United Parcel Service General Services Co. ( UPS ) for a total subscription price of EUR 10,000,000.00. As per the shareholder agreement signed between UPS and the Company on that date, the Company will convert up to 3% of the order value into the right to purchase a number of Ordinary Shares if it enters into a binding agreement for the provision of a further at least 10,000 electric vehicles.

C-001.rationale: Claim asserts a named US-listed counterparty (UPS, CIK 0001090727) has placed a material purchase order with Arrival for 10,000 vans; UPS's own SEC filings would disclose such a significant $1.2B supply commitment.

C-005.rationale: Claim asserts Arrival produces the Arrival Van and Arrival Bus (complete vehicles); NHTSA registration confirms whether these are registered as complete vehicles or incomplete/chassis-only.

Claim emphasizes 'strong IP portfolios' and vertical integration controlling 70% of Van and 40% of Bus materials; patent portfolio should show depth across materials, manufacturing, and vehicle systems to support the claim of proprietary ownership.

findings.claim_text: Arrival owns or controls approximately 70% of the Arrival Van and approximately 40% of the materials used to produce the Arrival Bus.
findings.M_check: Patent portfolio depth for 'strong IP portfolios' claim + NHTSA manufacturer registration for vehicle production claims
findings.M_value: 135 total patents with only 5 relevant to vehicle systems/manufacturing/drivetrain (3.7%); zero patents in materials science category despite 40-70% material ownership claim; NHTSA shows zero complete vehicle registrations for Arrival
findings.interpretation: The patent evidence shows Arrival holds some IP in manufacturing processes, vehicle systems, and drivetrain (thermal management, battery modules, robotic production), supporting the general vertical-integration narrative. However, the portfolio is extremely thin on materials science—zero patents in the 'materials/composite/panel/body' category—which directly contradicts the claim of owning 40-70% of physical materials. The NHTSA non-registration as a manufacturer suggests Arrival may not produce complete vehicles domestically, raising questions about the scope of the claimed ownership percentages. The evidence partially supports the IP/manufacturing control angle but severely underdelivers on the materials ownership assertion.
